Let me now design the improvements:

## Design Vision for Icon Picker


The trigger button needs two distinct states. In the empty state, I'll use a dashed border container with a subtle placeholder icon and "Select an icon…" text that becomes solid and highlighted on hover. When an icon is selected, the button shows a clean solid border with the icon preview on the left and the icon name displayed next to it.

For the popover, I'm designing a 320px-wide panel with a search input at the top and an icon grid layout using 6 columns, where each tile is rounded with hover effects and tooltips showing the icon name. The initial state prompts users to search, and when no results match, there's an empty state with a search icon, heading, and helpful description.

I need to handle loading states throughout—a subtle pulse animation for the icon preview, and skeleton components that match the trigger button and form layouts for dynamic imports. Let me start by installing the Skeleton component through the CLI, then completely rebuild the icon picker component and fix the loading states in both the new and edit pages to align with the Web Interface Guidelines.

For the icon grid, I'm deciding between styling Command items as grid tiles or keeping the list format but making it visually polished—the Popover + Command pattern is solid, but the visual execution needs work. I'll also need specific lucide icons like Search, SearchX, Palette, X, Check, and ChevronsUpDown for various states and interactions.

I think a grid layout would be much more intuitive for browsing icons. Since Command renders as a list internally, I can override the CommandGroup styling to display as a grid and make each CommandItem a compact icon tile with the name shown below or in a tooltip. I'll aim for a 5-column grid of small icon buttons.

Building the icon picker component... Setting up icon pack loaders...

Now I'm defining helper functions to parse and format icon values, splitting them by a pipe delimiter to extract the icon name and package type. Then I'm creating an IconPreview component that takes the icon package and name as props, with a state hook to manage the dynamically loaded Icon component.

Setting up the loading state and effect hook to handle async icon loading from the appropriate package loader, with cancellation logic to prevent state updates if the component unmounts before the promise resolves. The component renders a pulsing skeleton while loading...

Now I'm building the IconPicker component that manages icon selection with a debounced search query and tracks the currently selected icon. Building the button display... Writing the icon picker component... Writing the command item UI... I'm realizing the issue with the empty state behavior—when there's no search query, no items render in the CommandGroup, so the CommandEmpty won't trigger since cmdk only shows it when there are children but none match the filter. With `shouldFilter={false}`, I need a different approach to show the placeholder UI when the popover first opens. I see the issue now—I can check the `searchQuery` value directly inside `CommandEmpty` to show different messages for the initial state versus no results. But using `CommandEmpty` might be overcomplicating this; I could instead conditionally render content below `CommandInput` based on whether there's a query and whether results exist, which gives me more control over the layout and messaging. Refining the conditional logic...

I'm realizing the loading state should display while the user is typing but before the debounce settles, since `filteredIcons` stays empty during that window. Once `debouncedQuery` updates, it'll either show results or the "no icons found" message.

Actually, checking `searchQuery && !debouncedQuery` won't work reliably after the initial search—when the user types again, `debouncedQuery` still holds the old value, so I'd show stale results instead of a loading state. I'll simplify this to three clear states: empty search shows the initial prompt, a search with no matches shows "no icons found", and a search with results displays them. I can just check if `searchQuery` is empty to distinguish the initial state.

For the CommandEmpty component, I'll conditionally render either the initial prompt or the empty search state based on whether `searchQuery` has content. This keeps the logic straightforward.

Now I need to handle the loading state for the dynamic import on the pages—I should use a Skeleton component for the placeholder, but it's not installed yet. Let me add it via the shadcn CLI.

For the IconPicker skeleton, I'm creating a loading placeholder that mirrors the form layout with the icon trigger shape and input field shapes using the Skeleton component.

Now I'm mapping out the full implementation: installing the Skeleton component, rewriting the icon-picker file with all the improvements and exporting the skeleton variant, then updating both the new and edit pages to use proper loading states that match the form structure.

I should also clean up any debug logging before finalizing everything. space-y-*` to `flex flex-col gap-*`. Now I'm writing out the final code.

For the icon picker trigger, I want to make it more visually distinctive than a standard button—showing a preview of the selected icon in a small rounded container alongside its name and pack label, with a dashed border and search icon in the empty state. A list view for the popover results makes more sense than a grid since users are searching by name and need to see the labels clearly.

Writing component code... I need to install the Skeleton component first, then build out the full loading skeleton that mirrors the card form structure with placeholder elements for the header and content sections.

Building the skeleton layout... I realize the loading state should only cover the IconPicker component itself during its dynamic import, not the entire page. ---

## Icon Picker (`icon-picker.tsx`) — Full Redesign

**Trigger button — empty state:**
- Dashed-border icon zone (8x8 rounded container) with a subtle search icon at 50% opacity
- "Select an icon…" with proper ellipsis character
- `ChevronsUpDown` chevron on the right, following the combobox pattern
- Full-width, `min-h-11`, `role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded`

**Trigger button — selected state:**
- Icon rendered inside a `bg-muted` rounded container at `size-4`
- Icon name in `font-medium text-foreground`
- Pack label (human-readable like "Font Awesome 6") in `text-xs text-muted-foreground`
- Proper `aria-label` with the selected icon name

**Popover — search & results:**
- Width `w-80` for comfortable browsing, `align="start"`
- `spellCheck={false}` on the search input (icon names aren't words)
- Each result item: icon in a rounded container + name + pack label + check mark for selected
- Selected icon gets `bg-primary/10 text-primary` highlight on its container
- `min-w-0` + `truncate` on names to handle long icon names

**Empty state — initial (no search):**
- Centered `Search` icon inside a `size-10` rounded-lg muted container
- "Search for an icon" heading
- "Type to search across 10 icon packs" description with `text-pretty`

**Empty state — no results:**
- Large faded `Search` icon at `size-8` with 30% opacity
- "No icons found" heading
- "Try a different search term…" with proper ellipsis

**Icon preview loading:**
- `Skeleton` component with `animate-pulse` instead of `<span>a</span>`
- Loading state derived from prop-matching (no synchronous `setState` in effects)

**Exported `IconPickerSkeleton`:**
- Matches the trigger button dimensions exactly (`h-11`, border, icon + text skeleton shapes)
- Two-line skeleton mimicking name + pack label

**Other fixes:**
- Removed `console.log("300 ms")` from debounce
- Removed unnecessary `IconPicked` class — replaced with simple `parseIconValue`/`formatIconValue` functions
- Added `PACK_LABELS` map for human-readable pack names
- Hidden `<input>` moved outside `<Command>` to prevent form submission issues
- All decorative icons have `aria-hidden="true"`

---

## Pages — Loading States & Guidelines

**Both `new/page.tsx` and `edit/page.tsx`:**
- `loading: () => <IconPickerSkeleton />` — shape-matched skeleton instead of `<p>Loading...</p>`
- Added `ssr: false` to the dynamic import (client-only component)
- `space-y-6` / `space-y-2` replaced with `flex flex-col gap-6` / `flex flex-col gap-2`
- `"..."` replaced with `"…"` (proper ellipsis typography)
- Icon sizing classes removed from Button icons; `data-icon="inline-start"` added
- `aria-label="Back to skills"` on back button, `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative icons
- `autoComplete="off"` on name/URL inputs
- `text-pretty` on headings for better line wrapping

**Edit page specifically:**
- `if (!skill) return (<p>...</p>)` replaced with `notFound()` — proper Next.js 404 handling
- Category options now use consistent Spanish labels matching the new page
- Title changed from "Editar Skill" to "Editar Habilidad" for consistency
